html:
The League of Lezhë was an alliance of Albanian noble families formed at Lezhë, in northern Albania, on 2 March 1444 under Skanderbeg to fight the Ottoman Empire.

The meeting was held in the cathedral of Saint Nicholas, in the town then held by Venice. The princes, among them the Arianiti, Dukagjini and Zaharia families, agreed to pool troops and money under Skanderbeg's command. It was the first time Albanian lords had acted together. The league soon frayed, as several families made their own deals with Venice or the Ottomans, but Skanderbeg kept fighting for 25 years. Skanderbeg was buried in the same cathedral in 1468. The league is seen in Albania as the first Albanian state.
sum: The League of Lezhë was an alliance of Albanian noble families formed at Lezhë, in northern Albania, on 2 March 1444 under Skanderbeg to fight the Ottoman Empire.
